description: The Maharashtra Research and Vigilance for Enhanced Law Enforcement is expected to strengthen the state’s AI capabilities and help the police tackle law enforcement more effectively.
body_lead: With it becoming clear that artificial intelligence (AI) is here to stay, the Maharashtra government has decided to efficiently leverage this powerful tool to solve crimes with the help of a new company — the Maharashtra Research and Vigilance for Enhanced Law Enforcement (MARVEL). MARVEL has been created to enhance intelligence capabilities and improve crime prediction, enabling the state police force to tackle law enforcement more effectively using AI. With this, Maharashtra has become the first state in the country to create an independent entity for AI in law enforcement.
